first_reader_check.about: Whether a published tag on a released mathematics item is required to match the key, tested by programs that lack the tagged operation.
first_reader_check.shown: Catalog 105 tests, 0 Holm, two existence rows (Regents geometry 0.323 n=279; EQAO grade 6 0.500 n=40 at the second-smallest option). Strategy: STAAR grade-5 arithmetic closure 21/40 is the only Holm reject and failed powered replication (21/64=0.328, CI covers chance). Image-channel backsolving 14/15 Algebra I items with a unique printed equation, n=15, coverage 15/598, not Holm, not a census. Masked-stem LM: Qwen2.5 and Phi-4 on Algebra I n=358 and Algebra II n=248; Phi-4 geometry unclaimed (0.229 n=118); Mistral does not clear; human 15/40 uninformative null. TIMSS knowing/applying/reasoning remain null at selected-response n about 50 to 80.
first_reader_check.what_is_new: A three-family requirement census on tagged public mathematics: masked-stem (quantities withheld) increment on the choices-only construction, publisher tags, Holm within family, TIMSS cells, a strategy discovery that does not replicate, and an image-channel backsolve existence row on rare unique-equation Algebra I items.
first_reader_check.why_a_big_deal: If a pass does not require the tagged operation, accountability, curriculum evaluation, and research that treat the tag as the competency are reading the wrong quantity. On Algebra I and Algebra II masked-stem hits, matching the key need not execute the tagged computation on the givens. On the 14 Algebra I substitution hits, matching the key need not solve.
